notes.title: Early Access Hotfix 0.2.1 and World 2 & 3 release schedule
notes.content:
Hello to everyone!

After we received feedback, we have made some changes to the game, and it's systems for you to play better, faster, and smoother (The changes list will be at the bottom)

This Friday (Feb 8th) we will release the second world, which will include five more themed levels, new enemies, new challenges, and new power.

Feb 22nd we plan on releasing the third world as well, so stay tuned for more information about that in our social accounts.
Twitter: @evgeny_gutman
Instagram: @bulletbears

Thank you for your time and feedback!


List of changes:

Changed: the Camera system
Changed: Player movement system
Added: Bonus teleports at levels 2 & 4
Added: Resolution refresh rate in the settings
Added: Text above checkpoints and Finish flowers
Fixed: Resolution duplicates showing
Fixed: Some lighting cause extreme frame drops
Fixed: Level 2 inside the tree is see through
Fixed: Opening cutscene volume

notes.title: We are live!
notes.content:
We have just released the game!

Thank you all for the support in the development of the game.
But now the real work has started, and it's to continue the development with your feedback!

If you have and questions or feedback regarding the game, go to the community tab and post your thoughts!
